name: Race condition on coupon redemption

input.title: Single-use coupon can be redeemed N times via concurrent requests
input.summary: POST /coupons/redeem checks the coupon's remaining count and then decrements it without a transaction or row lock. Sending N concurrent requests with the same coupon_id drains more than the coupon's balance.

attacker.identity: authenticated ordinary user with one valid coupon

input.root_cause: TOCTOU between SELECT remaining_count and UPDATE remaining_count = remaining_count - 1

rationale: Time-of-check to time-of-use race. Reproduced locally with 100 concurrent requests; coupon balance went to -99.
